title: Student Assistant
location: Ørestad, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
description_md:
**Your impact begins here**

As Student Assistant in the Legal, Compliance & Quality team, you will support colleagues across Novo Denmark on a broad range of legal and compliance activities. You will work on contract drafting and review, legal research, data privacy and AI governance questions, and various ad hoc projects, while learning how law works in a life sciences company. Your work helps colleagues move forward with confidence and contributes to Novo’s purpose of driving change for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What you’ll bring**

You are a proactive and curious law student who enjoys taking responsibility and being a reliable partner to the people you support. We expect you to bring:

* Current enrolment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme within Law.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.
* A structured, organised and detail-oriented way of working.
* A proactive, reliable and service-minded approach.
* Confidence using digital tools and systems.
* Curiosity about pharma and the legal challenges within life sciences.

**What you’ll do**

You will support the team with a broad range of legal and compliance tasks, taking ownership of day-to-day work while learning from experienced colleagues. Your work will include:

* Support the drafting and review of contracts and templates.
* Carry out legal research and share clear findings with the team.
* Help answer data privacy questions and contribute to AI governance matters.
* Support colleagues with day-to-day legal and compliance questions.
* Provide stakeholder support and follow up on your assigned tasks.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Legal, Compliance & Quality team in Novo Denmark where you will report to the Director Legal, Compliance & Quality, Christian Bennet Rosenbæk.

The Legal, Compliance & Quality team acts as a trusted partner to the business, supporting a broad range of activities across Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Public Affairs, and other functions.

The role is office-based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, however, we recognise the importance of balancing work and academics and strive to provide additional flexibility during exam periods whenever possible.  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to take ownership of your tasks and supported to perform at your best. You will get hands-on experience with legal and compliance topics in a life sciences setting, learn from colleagues who work with them every day, and be encouraged to make your voice heard.

**Salary and Benefits**: This position is hourly paid, and the position is approximately 15 hours per week. For this position, the hourly base rate is 209,27 DKK based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build practical legal and compliance experience and support colleagues across Novo Denmark, apply for the Student Assistant Legal & Compliance role by 18 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Anna Aagaard Saks (zaaa@novonordisk.com) or Sigrid Duus ([sgdf@novonordisk.com](mailto:sgdf@novonordisk.com)) from the Legal, Compliance & Quality team.

             

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
